 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT MAHAJAN  ORDER % 10.07.2025 1.

The petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No. 136/2025 dated 28.02.2025, under Section 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 registered at Police Station North Rohini on the ground that the parties have settled their dispute and statement in that regard was also made before the learned Magistrate.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner and complainant were in a consensual relationship, however, the complaint regard to offence under Section 376 of the IPC was filed due to certain differences.
He submits that the complainant after giving a statement before the learned Magistrate is not cooperating.
4. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.
5. Mr. Sanjeev Kumar, Advocate who appears through video This is a digitally signed order.

6.
Reply, if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.
